data.name: Starburn
data.description: As a standard action, the shaman causes one creature within 30 feet to burn like a star. The creature takes %1d6 points of fire damage and emits bright light for 1 round. A successful Fortitude saving throw (DC %2) halves the damage and negates the emission of bright light. The shaman can use this hex %3/day, but must wait 1d4 rounds between uses.|ShamanStarburnDice|ShamanStarburnDC|ShamanStarburnTimes
